title: Engineer and test individual decision features before classifier promotion
description: Agreed plan (2026-10-05): separate feature admission from fitted-classifier promotion. Current three-control scheduler bundles supporting questions; a losing bundle does not disprove individual concepts. Implement in order: (1) persistent individual feature bank with stable identity, wording revisions, intended concept, options, training evidence references, rationale, lineage, coverage and trial history; proposed/measured/deferred/deployed states, no permanent deletion on failure; (2) descriptive class-conditional probability/missingness diagnostics with counts, not held-out performance claims; (3) one-question additions against one frozen incumbent rubric/example list/model/partitions/weighting/fit, cached full requests and explicit budgets; (4) bounded pairs/groups and leave-one-question-out ablations for incremental value, redundancy and interactions; (5) wording refinement using training feedback only and fair retry as evidence grows; (6) reusable lifecycle events and Rich inspection of feature bank, trial diffs, actual optimizer exchanges, Jev requests, fits and deployment. Keep measured Brier promotion gate: any strict improvement currently qualifies, so do not merely lower a nonexistent large threshold. Development/audit labels must never enter optimizer briefing or demonstrations; sealed scoreboard must not steer search. Specs first with fake clients for isolation, deterministic budgets, revisions/retries, restart safety and failed-trial incumbent preservation. First milestone: auditable single-feature addition through decision answers, numerical fit and visible development result. Combination experiments follow after verification. Evaluations go in the separate evaluations repository; no DSPy, retrieval or input filtering. This is planned work, not implemented capability.

comments.author: home
comments.text: First implementation milestone complete, verified offline: persistent individual feature bank with stable definition IDs, same-name wording lineage, training-evidence fingerprints, retained trial history and proposed/measured/deferred/deployed inspection. Scheduler admits questions independently and fits up to three single-question additions or wording revisions per cycle, preserving other deployed questions and one common incumbent; rubric/example trials stay isolated. Numerical fits emit class-conditional training-probability diagnostics before fitting, never generalization claims. Request-time datetime is frozen across comparisons and persisted for restart. Completed discovery is checkpointed, unchanged evidence cached, explicit per-cycle feature cap supported. Rich H shows bank definitions, signal and outcomes; core exposes feature_bank and max_feature_trials. Specs first; 427 offline tests pass including reviewer integration, budgets, lineage, malformed probabilities and partition safety. New paid collection NOT run. Preflight on frozen 87-vote snapshot: up to five fits, ceiling 373 Jev requests / 3 Luna calls; one-feature option is 227 / 3. Historical grouped-question results are not relabeled as individual trials. Combination/ablation search remains future work; story remains in progress.
